name: Gacha
desc_vn: Chiêu mộ anh hùng mạnh mẽ, tăng cường sức mạnh.
desc: Recruit powerful heroes, enhance strength.
desc_ma: Rekrut wira kuat, tingkatkan kekuatan.
desc_en: Recruit powerful heroes, enhance strength.
desc_th: รับสมัครฮีโร่ทรงพลัง เพิ่มพลังต่อสู้
desc_in: Rekrut pahlawan kuat, tingkatkan kekuatan.
desc_ph: Mag-recruit ng malalakas na bayani, palakasin ang lakas.

name: Formation
desc_vn: Đội hình xuất phát, điều chỉnh vị trí.
desc: Set up your starting lineup, adjust positions.
desc_ma: Susun formasi, laraskan posisi.
desc_en: Set up your starting lineup, adjust positions.
desc_th: ตั้งทีมเริ่มต้น ปรับตำแหน่ง
desc_in: Formasi awal, atur posisi.
desc_ph: Simulan ang formation, ayusin ang posisyon.

name: Heavenly Stroll
name_th: สวรรค์แห่งการเดินเล่น
desc_vn: Huấn luyện mỹ nữ dị giới, nhận được chúc phúc của mỹ nữ.
desc: Train beautiful otherworldly maidens, receive their blessings.
desc_ma: Latih wanita cantik dari dunia lain, terima berkat daripada mereka.
desc_en: Train beautiful otherworldly maidens, receive their blessings.
desc_th: ฝึกฝนหญิงงามต่างโลก รับพรจากหญิงงาม
desc_in: Latih wanita cantik dari dunia lain, dapatkan berkah dari mereka.
desc_ph: Sanayin ang magagandang babae mula sa ibang mundo, tumanggap ng pagpapala mula sa kanila.

name: Hero Upgrade
name_th: การอัปเกรดฮีโร่
desc_vn: Nâng cấp anh hùng, tăng cường năng lượng và sức chiến đấu
desc: Upgrade heroes, increase energy and combat power.
desc_ma: Naik taraf wira, tingkatkan tenaga dan kekuatan bertempur.
desc_en: Upgrade heroes, increase energy and combat power.
desc_th: อัปเกรดฮีโร่ เพิ่มพลังและความแข็งแกร่ง
desc_in: Upgrade pahlawan, tingkatkan energi dan kekuatan bertarung.
desc_ph: I-upgrade ang bayani, dagdagan ang enerhiya at lakas sa labanan.

name: Skill Upgrade
name_th: การอัปเกรดทักษะ
desc_vn: Nâng cấp kỹ năng, tăng uy lực kỹ năng
desc: Upgrade skills, boost skill effectiveness.
desc_ma: Naik taraf kemahiran, tingkatkan kuasa kemahiran.
desc_en: Upgrade skills, boost skill effectiveness.
desc_th: อัปเกรดสกิล เพิ่มพลังโจมตี
desc_in: Upgrade keterampilan, tingkatkan kekuatan skill.
desc_ph: I-upgrade ang mga kasanayan, palakasin ang bisa ng skill.

name: Hero Upgrade
name_th: การอัปเกรดฮีโร่
desc_vn: Nhanh chóng tăng cấp tướng
desc: Quickly level up your heroes.
desc_ma: Tingkatkan tahap wira dengan cepat.
desc_en: Quickly level up your heroes.
desc_th: เลื่อนขั้นฮีโร่ได้อย่างรวดเร็ว
desc_in: Naikkan level pahlawan dengan cepat.
desc_ph: Mabilisang pag-level up ng bayani.

name: Shop
desc_vn: Cửa hàng đã mở, bạn có thể mua các loại đạo cụ khác nhau.
desc: The shop is open, you can buy various items.
desc_ma: Kedai dibuka, anda boleh membeli pelbagai barang.
desc_en: The shop is open, you can buy various items.
desc_th: ร้านค้าเปิดแล้ว คุณสามารถซื้อไอเทมต่างๆ
desc_in: Toko dibuka, kamu bisa membeli berbagai item.
desc_ph: Bukas na ang tindahan, maaari kang bumili ng iba't ibang item.

name: Photo Album
desc_vn: Thu thập anh hùng, mở khóa bách khoa toàn thư, và trở thành chỉ huy mạnh mẽ hơn.
desc: Collect heroes, unlock the encyclopedia, and become a stronger commander.
desc_ma: Kumpul wira, buka ensiklopedia, jadi ketua yang lebih kuat.
desc_en: Collect heroes, unlock the encyclopedia, and become a stronger commander.
desc_th: สะสมฮีโร่ ปลดล็อกสารานุกรม เป็นผู้บัญชาการที่แข็งแกร่งขึ้น
desc_in: Kumpulkan pahlawan, buka ensiklopedia, dan jadi komandan yang lebih kuat.
desc_ph: Kolektahin ang mga bayani, i-unlock ang encyclopedia, at maging mas malakas na komander.

name: Items
desc_vn: Trang bị vật phẩm siêu việt, nhận thêm hiệu ứng.
desc: Equip superior items, gain additional effects.
desc_ma: Perlengkapan hebat, terima kesan tambahan.
desc_en: Equip superior items, gain additional effects.
desc_th: สวมใส่อุปกรณ์ขั้นสูง รับผลเสริมพิเศษ
desc_in: Perlengkapan super, dapatkan efek tambahan.
desc_ph: Gamitin ang super na kagamitan, tumanggap ng dagdag na epekto.

name: Daily Quests
name_th: เควสประจำวัน
desc_vn: Bắt đầu nhiệm vụ hàng ngày để nhận thưởng.
desc: Start daily missions to receive rewards.
desc_ma: Mulakan misi harian untuk terima ganjaran.
desc_en: Start daily missions to receive rewards.
desc_th: เริ่มภารกิจประจำวันเพื่อรับรางวัล
desc_in: Mulai misi harian untuk mendapatkan hadiah.
desc_ph: Simulan ang araw-araw na misyon para makatanggap ng gantimpala.

name: Training Privileges
name_th: สิทธิพิเศษการฝึกอบรม
desc_vn: Nâng cấp đặc quyền huấn luyện, nhận nhiều ưu đãi khác nhau
desc: Upgrade training privileges, enjoy various benefits.
desc_ma: Naik taraf keistimewaan latihan, terima pelbagai kelebihan.
desc_en: Upgrade training privileges, enjoy various benefits.
desc_th: อัปเกรดสิทธิ์การฝึก รับสิทธิพิเศษมากมาย
desc_in: Upgrade hak istimewa pelatihan, dapatkan banyak keuntungan.
desc_ph: I-upgrade ang training privileges, tumanggap ng iba't ibang benepisyo.

name: Refinement
desc_vn: Luyện thuộc tính bẩm sinh, nhận anh hùng hoàn hảo
desc: Train innate attributes, obtain perfect heroes.
desc_ma: Latih atribut semula jadi, dapatkan wira sempurna.
desc_en: Train innate attributes, obtain perfect heroes.
desc_th: ฝึกคุณสมบัติพิเศษ รับฮีโร่สมบูรณ์แบบ
desc_in: Latih atribut bawaan, dapatkan pahlawan sempurna.
desc_ph: Sanayin ang likas na katangian, magkaroon ng perpektong bayani.

name: Arena
desc_vn: Đấu trường mở ra, thời khắc so tài thực lực đã đến.
desc: The arena opens, the moment to compete has arrived.
desc_ma: Arena dibuka, masa untuk bertarung menunjukkan kekuatan.
desc_en: The arena opens, the moment to compete has arrived.
desc_th: อารีน่าเปิดแล้ว ถึงเวลาประลองฝีมือ
desc_in: Arena dibuka, saatnya bertanding menunjukkan kemampuan.
desc_ph: Bukas na ang arena, panahon na para ipakita ang lakas.

name: Leaderboard
name_th: กระดานคะแนน
desc_vn: Bảng xếp hạng đã mở, bạn có thể xem thứ hạng thực lực của mình.
desc: Leaderboard is available, check your ranking.
desc_ma: Jadual kedudukan dibuka, lihat kedudukan anda.
desc_en: Leaderboard is available, check your ranking.
desc_th: ตารางอันดับเปิดแล้ว ดูอันดับพลังของคุณ
desc_in: Papan peringkat dibuka, lihat peringkat kekuatanmu.
desc_ph: Bukas na ang leaderboard, tingnan ang iyong ranggo.

name: Event Dungeon
name_th: ดันเจี้ยนกิจกรรม
desc_vn: Mở phó bản sự kiện, nhận tài nguyên nhanh chóng
desc: Unlock event dungeons, quickly gather resources.
desc_ma: Buka penjara acara, dapatkan sumber dengan cepat.
desc_en: Unlock event dungeons, quickly gather resources.
desc_th: เปิดดันเจี้ยนกิจกรรม รับทรัพยากรเร็วขึ้น
desc_in: Buka dungeon event, dapatkan sumber daya dengan cepat.
desc_ph: Buksan ang event dungeon, mabilis makakuha ng resources.

name: Guild
desc_vn: Bang hội mở, tìm kiếm đồng đội.
desc: Guilds are open, find teammates.
desc_ma: Gild dibuka, cari rakan sepasukan.
desc_en: Guilds are open, find teammates.
desc_th: เปิดกิลด์ หาทีมงานร่วมมือ
desc_in: Guild dibuka, cari teman satu tim.
desc_ph: Bukas na ang guild, maghanap ng mga kasamahan.

name: Rebirth
name_th: การเกิดใหม่
desc_vn: Tái sinh anh hùng, hoàn trả nhanh tài nguyên bồi dưỡng
desc: Rebirth heroes, quickly reclaim training resources.
desc_ma: Reinkarnasi wira, pulihkan sumber dengan pantas.
desc_en: Rebirth heroes, quickly reclaim training resources.
desc_th: เกิดใหม่ฮีโร่ คืนทรัพยากรฝึกได้รวดเร็ว
desc_in: Reinkarnasi pahlawan, cepat dapatkan kembali sumber daya.
desc_ph: Rebirth ng bayani, mabilis na ibalik ang mga resources.

name: Growth Path
name_th: เส้นทางเติบโต
desc_vn: Hành trình trưởng thành bắt đầu, thử thách không giới hạn.
desc: The growth journey begins, endless challenges await.
desc_ma: Perjalanan pertumbuhan bermula, cabaran tanpa had.
desc_en: The growth journey begins, endless challenges await.
desc_th: เริ่มต้นเส้นทางเติบโต ท้าทายไม่จำกัด
desc_in: Perjalanan pertumbuhan dimulai, tantangan tanpa batas.
desc_ph: Magsimula ng growth journey, walang katapusang hamon.

name: Potential
desc_vn: Tăng tiềm năng, cường hóa thuộc tính
desc: Increase potential, strengthen attributes.
desc_ma: Tingkatkan potensi, kuatkan atribut.
desc_en: Increase potential, strengthen attributes.
desc_th: เพิ่มศักยภาพ เสริมคุณสมบัติ
desc_in: Tingkatkan potensi, perkuat atribut.
desc_ph: Dagdagan ang potensyal, palakasin ang attributes.

name: Affinity
desc_vn: Tặng quà, tăng độ hảo cảm của tướng
desc: Give gifts, raise hero affinity.
desc_ma: Beri hadiah, tingkatkan keakraban wira.
desc_en: Give gifts, raise hero affinity.
desc_th: มอบของขวัญ เพิ่มความสัมพันธ์กับฮีโร่
desc_in: Berikan hadiah, tingkatkan hubungan dengan pahlawan.
desc_ph: Magbigay ng regalo, pataasin ang pagkakaibigan sa bayani.

name: Talent
desc_vn: Kích hoạt thiên phú, cường hóa thực lực
desc: Activate talents, enhance combat strength.
desc_ma: Aktifkan bakat, kuatkan keupayaan.
desc_en: Activate talents, enhance combat strength.
desc_th: เปิดใช้งานพรสวรรค์ เสริมความแข็งแกร่ง
desc_in: Aktifkan bakat, perkuat kemampuan.
desc_ph: I-activate ang talent, palakasin ang lakas.

name: Dispatch
desc_vn: Phái cử bắt đầu, dễ dàng nhận thưởng
desc: Dispatch begins, easily receive rewards.
desc_ma: Mula penugasan, mudah dapat ganjaran.
desc_en: Dispatch begins, easily receive rewards.
desc_th: เริ่มส่งภารกิจ รับรางวัลง่าย
desc_in: Mulai pengiriman, mudah dapat hadiah.
desc_ph: Simulan ang dispatch, madaling makakuha ng reward.
